hook: Hackers drained $388 million from Bitget after hiding inside its servers for 25 days.

sections.voiceover: Hackers drained $388 million from Bitget after hiding inside its servers for 25 days.
b_roll: Digital server rack animation showing breach alarm

sections.voiceover: Slowmist investigators found malicious code executing on August 31 inside a compromised third-party security product. Unauthorized transfers began at 18:31 UTC on September 24. Where did the $388 million vanish?
Except automated risk controls blocked withdrawals once unauthorized transfers started at 18:31 UTC.
CEO Gracy Chen froze $1.1 million of the stolen funds. Bitget replenished its Protection Fund back up to $300 million.
The Bitget Protection Fund sits at $300 million.
